faq_heading: New construction in North Coquitlam: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in North Coquitlam sold for?
faq.a: 195 condos sold in North Coquitlam at a median of $600,000, with the middle half between $510,000 and $669,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in North Coquitlam?
faq.a: Condos in North Coquitlam took 23 days at a median to sell.

faq.q: Which homes in North Coquitlam are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in North Coquitlam, condos had the newest median build year, 2009.

blocks.text: The listings above are the active new-construction listings in North Coquitlam, picked by setting the MLS® age field to 0 or less. That catches homes completed this year and homes listed before they are finished. Over November 2025 to October 2026, the busiest home type in North Coquitlam was condos: 195 sales at a median of $600,000, and 1 type had 5 or more sales.

items.t: North Coquitlam: 195 condos sold at a median of $600,000, with the middle half between $510,000 and $669,000. The median condo took 23 days to sell and closed at 97.3% of list.

blocks.text: 3 Townhomes also sold in North Coquitlam, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How North Coquitlam compares with the rest of Coquitlam

items.t: Of 8 Coquitlam sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, North Coquitlam ranks 4th highest at $600,000; the range is $426,250 (Central Coquitlam) to $695,000 (New Horizons). Canyon Springs ($530,000) sits just below and Coquitlam West ($620,000) sits just above.
